# clickup Provider

Terraform provider for managing ClickUp infrastructure via the ClickUp Public APIs (V2 and V3). Automate workspaces, spaces, folders, lists, tasks, goals, webhooks, chat channels, time entries, and permissions under Terraform Plugin Framework protocol version 6.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    clickup = {
      source  = "rixlhq/clickup"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "clickup" {
  api_token = var.clickup_api_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) ClickUp API token. Can be set via the `CLICKUP_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Override the ClickUp V2 API base URL. Can be set via the `CLICKUP_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `https://api.clickup.com/api`.
- `v3_base_url` (String) Override the ClickUp V3 API base URL. Can be set via the `CLICKUP_V3_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `https://api.clickup.com/`.
